title: Mgbo language - Wikipedia
text: The Mgbo language, ' Mgbolizhia', is an Igboid language spoken by the Mgbo people in Ebonyi state in Nigeria. It forms a dialect cluster with closely related Izii, Ezza, and Ikwo languages though they are only marginally mutually intelligible.

title: Mgbo language — Grokipedia
text: Mgbolizhia, commonly known as Mgbo or Ngbo, is an Igboid language of the Niger-Congo family spoken primarily by the Mgbo people in Ebonyi State, southeastern Nigeria. [1][2][3] It forms part of the Izi-Ezaa-Ikwo-Mgbo dialect cluster, where it is not mutually intelligible with neighboring varieties like Izi or Ezaa, leading speakers to use English or central Igbo for intercommunication.
